python/mirage/utils/generated/encoding_data.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/utils/generated/encoding_data.ts are generated
by scripts/gen_encoding_tables.py from the WHATWG Encoding Standard as last
updated on 21 May 2026, the commit snapshot at
https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/a985b62a9b45c17da3e17a9f0a0b4e30c34c4a8a/:
its encoding labels (encodings.json) and the indexes of its single-byte
encodings (index-*.txt), laid out as lookup tables. The standard carries this
notice (https://github.com/whatwg/encoding/blob/main/LICENSE), and the tables
are portions of it incorporated into source code:
